scope: Proposition 7.6 (Retained-edge planar rigidity) of the manuscript “Every four-dimensional Kakeya set has full Hausdorff dimension” (preprints/Every-four-dimensional-Kakeya-set-has-full-Hausdorff-dimension-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 074 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 30d0c186aa9c697d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 115. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under Assumption 7.2, after increasing to a new subpower K∗, there are a represented κ0, at least h−2/K∗ original edges of Gκ0 , and |λ|+|cA|+|cB| ≤ K∗ such that on those edges |x2 − λx1 − cA| + |y2 − λy1 − cB| ≤ K∗h. No fixed-power dependence of K∗ on the initial subpower K is asserted.
